name: Audit component
content:
You inspect cross-spoke consumer relationships for one component note. Human-facing docs under knowledge/docs are not rewritten in this run.

Inputs:
- Component id: {{runtime.audit_component_id}}

Procedure (must):
1. Inspect whether any consumer spoke depends on the component but is missing from consumed_by.
2. Record anything you cannot verify instead of assuming it passes.
3. Do not write knowledge files on disk.
4. As your final stdout line only, print a single JSON object (no markdown fence): `{"missing_consumer":"<spoke or empty>","unverified":"<reason or empty>"}`. Use empty strings when nothing is missing or unverified.
